name: PLANCOM: Planetary Commander
source:
Take on the role of a young man thrown into a powerful position by mere circumstance. Manage your resources, lead your people and most importantly, command the populus. Set inside of a dark and gloomy narrative, with a choice-based nature, you can either be the people's last glimmer of hope, or be the one that smolders their last spark of light in the darkness of the world.

[From [url=https://aimfortheribs.itch.io/plancom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名因环境而被推上权力职位的年轻人。管理你的资源，领导你的人民，最重要的是，指挥民众。在黑暗阴沉的叙事中，具有基于选择的本质，你要么成为人们最后的一线希望，要么成为在黑暗世界中闷烧最后一丝光明的人。

[来自[url=https://aimfortheribs.itch.io/plancom]Itch.io[/url]]
